dedupe_keys.name: hk bfetd building typology preparation code

description: The HK-BFETD GitHub repository publishes Python pipeline scripts that build the Hong Kong building function and energy typology release. Its README lists numbered preprocessing stages, shared configuration and inputs from official building footprints, building records, OpenStreetMap, Overture and zoning information. The public repository licence metadata identifies MIT for the code. It prepares spatial building classes and mixed-use proportions that can inform city-scale energy or digital-twin models, with model-energyplus as a possible downstream simulator. A caveat is that some official and third-party raw inputs have their own terms and are not redistributed in the Zenodo output. The Zenodo description also warns that externally mediated artificial-intelligence stages may not rerun byte identically when service versions change. The code repository is a separate reusable workflow from the CC BY 4.0 output dataset. I read its own metadata and README but did not clone it, install dependencies, acquire upstream layers or rerun the ten-stage process.
